controls.title: Search Open Technical Databases
controls.description: Adversaries may search for publicly available research and technical documentation to learn how and where AI is used within a victim organization.

controls.title: Search Open AI Vulnerability Analysis
controls.description: Much like the Search Open Technical Databases, there is often ample research available on the vulnerabilities of common AI models.

controls.title: Acquire Public AI Artifacts
controls.description: Adversaries may search public sources, including cloud storage, public-facing services, and software or data repositories, to identify AI artifacts.

controls.title: Search Victim-Owned Websites
controls.description: Adversaries may search websites owned by the victim for information that can be used during targeting.

controls.title: Search Application Repositories
controls.description: Adversaries may search open application repositories during targeting.

controls.title: Active Scanning: Scan for Exposed AI Infrastructure
controls.description: "Adversaries may scan network ports and services to identify deployed\ \ AI backends, model-serving endpoints, and AI agent infrastructure reachable\ \ over the internet.

controls.title: AI Supply Chain Compromise
controls.description: Adversaries may gain initial access to a system by compromising the unique portions of the AI supply chain.

controls.title: User Execution
controls.description: An adversary may rely upon a user to load, execute, interpret, or otherwise use a malicious or unsafe artifact.

controls.title: Valid Accounts
controls.description: Adversaries may obtain and abuse credentials of existing accounts as a means of gaining Initial Access.

controls.title: Discover AI Model Ontology
controls.description: Adversaries may discover the ontology of an AI model's output space, for example, the types of objects a model can detect.

controls.title: Evade AI Model
controls.description: Adversaries can Craft Adversarial Data that prevents an AI model from correctly identifying the contents of the data or Generate Deepfakes that fools an AI model expecting authentic data.

controls.title: Obtain Capabilities
controls.description: Adversaries may search for and obtain software capabilities for use in their operations.

controls.title: Develop Capabilities
controls.description: Adversaries may develop their own capabilities to support operations.

controls.title: Manipulate AI Model
controls.description: "Adversaries may manipulate an AI model artifact or its bundled components\ \ to change AI system behavior, introduce malicious code, or establish persistent\ \ malicious functionality.

controls.title: Publish Poisoned Datasets
controls.description: Adversary publishes poisoned datasets for victim consumption.

controls.title: Training Data Poisoning
controls.description: Adversaries may manipulate data used for training or fine-tuning an AI model to influence the resulting model's behavior.

controls.title: Establish Accounts
controls.description: Adversaries may create accounts with various services for use in targeting, to gain access to resources needed in AI Attack Staging, or for victim impersonation.

controls.title: Valid Accounts
controls.description: Exploiting legitimate agent credentials to access AI systems or data pipelines; Using compromised agent credentials to impersonate trusted agents in A2A channels

controls.title: Exfiltration via AI Inference API
controls.description: Adversaries may exfiltrate private information via AI Model Inference API Access.

controls.title: Exfiltration via AI Inference API: Infer Training Data Membership
controls.description: Adversaries may infer the membership of a data sample or global characteristics of the data in its training set, which raises privacy concerns.

controls.title: Exfiltration via AI Inference API: Invert AI Model
controls.description: AI models' training data could be reconstructed by exploiting the confidence scores that are available via an inference API.

controls.title: Exfiltration via AI Inference API: Extract AI Model
controls.description: Adversaries may extract a functional copy of a private model.

controls.title: Exfiltration via Cyber Means
controls.description: Adversaries may exfiltrate AI artifacts or other information relevant to their goals via traditional cyber means.

controls.title: Model Inversion
controls.description: Adversary reconstructs sensitive training examples from model outputs through systematic query campaigns; Reconstructing sensitive training data from model outputs

controls.title: Denial of AI Service
controls.description: Adversaries may target AI-enabled systems with a flood of requests for the purpose of degrading or shutting down the service.

controls.title: Information Disclosure
controls.description: Extraction of confidential information via targeted model queries

controls.title: Erode AI Model Integrity
controls.description: Adversaries may degrade the target model's performance with adversarial data inputs to erode confidence in the system over time.

controls.title: Data Poisoning
controls.description: Injecting malicious content into agent persistent memory or RAG stores; Injecting malicious data into training pipelines to corrupt model behaviour

controls.title: Cost Harvesting
controls.description: Adversaries may deliberately drive a victim's AI services beyond normal operating capacity with the intent of increasing the cost of services.

controls.title: AI Artifact Collection
controls.description: Adversaries may collect AI artifacts for Exfiltration or for use in AI Attack Staging.

controls.title: Data from Information Repositories
controls.description: Adversaries may leverage information repositories to mine valuable information.

controls.title: Data from Local System
controls.description: Adversaries may search local system sources, such as file systems and configuration files or local databases, to find files of interest and sensitive data prior to Exfiltration.

controls.title: AI Model Inference API Access
controls.description: Adversaries may gain access to a model via legitimate access to the inference API.

controls.title: Physical Environment Access
controls.description: In addition to the attacks that take place purely in the digital domain, adversaries may also exploit the physical environment for their attacks.

controls.title: Verify Attack
controls.description: Adversaries can verify the efficacy of their attack via an inference API or access to an offline copy of the target model.

controls.title: Craft Adversarial Data
controls.description: Adversarial data are inputs to an AI model that have been modified such that they cause the adversary's desired effect in the target model.

controls.title: Full AI Model Access
controls.description: Adversaries may gain full "white-box" access to an AI model.

controls.title: Disinformation
controls.description: Agent generates persuasive false information to manipulate human approvals; Adversary publishes false content in public repositories, documentation sites, or knowledge bases indexed by RAG systems; Using AI-generated content to deliberately spread false information

controls.title: AI-Enabled Product or Service
controls.description: Adversaries may use a product or service that uses artificial intelligence under the hood to gain access to the underlying AI model.

controls.title: External Harms
controls.description: Adversaries may abuse their access to a victim system and use its resources or capabilities to further their goals by causing harms external to that system.

controls.title: Exploit Public-Facing Application
controls.description: Adversaries may attempt to take advantage of a weakness in an Internet-facing computer or program using software, data, or commands in order to cause unintended or unanticipated behavior.

controls.title: Command and Scripting Interpreter
controls.description: Adversaries may abuse command and script interpreters to execute commands, scripts, or binaries.

controls.title: LLM Prompt Injection
controls.description: An adversary may craft malicious prompts as inputs to an LLM that cause the LLM to act in unintended ways.

controls.title: LLM Prompt Injection: Direct
controls.description: An adversary may inject prompts directly as a user of the LLM.

controls.title: LLM Prompt Injection: Indirect
controls.description: An adversary may inject prompts indirectly via a separate data channel that the LLM or AI agent ingests, such as text or multimedia pulled from documents, emails, databases or websites.

controls.title: Phishing
controls.description: Adversaries may send phishing messages to gain access to victim systems.

controls.title: Phishing: Spearphishing via Social Engineering LLM
controls.description: Adversaries may turn LLMs into targeted social engineers.

controls.title: AI Agent Tool Invocation
controls.description: Adversaries may use their access to an AI agent to invoke tools the agent has access to.

controls.title: LLM Jailbreak
controls.description: Adversaries may induce a large language model (LLM) to ignore, circumvent, or override its safety/alignment behaviors and/or guardrails to elicit outputs the model is intended to withhold.

controls.title: Unsecured Credentials
controls.description: Adversaries may search compromised systems to find and obtain insecurely stored credentials.

controls.title: Extract LLM System Prompt
controls.description: Adversaries may attempt to extract a large language model's (LLM) system prompt.

controls.title: LLM Data Leakage
controls.description: Adversaries may craft prompts that induce the LLM to leak sensitive information.

controls.title: Discover AI Model Outputs
controls.description: Adversaries may discover model outputs, such as class scores, whose presence is not required for the system to function and are not intended for use by the end user.

controls.title: Retrieval Content Crafting
controls.description: Adversaries may write content designed to be retrieved by user queries and influence a user of the system in some way.

controls.title: LLM Prompt Obfuscation
controls.description: Adversaries may hide or otherwise obfuscate prompt injections or retrieval content to avoid detection from humans, large language model (LLM) guardrails, or other detection mechanisms.

controls.title: RAG Poisoning
controls.description: Adversaries may inject malicious content into data indexed by a retrieval augmented generation (RAG) system to contaminate a future thread through RAG-based search results.

controls.title: Automated Collection
controls.description: Adversaries may use automated techniques to collect data from AI systems and supporting enterprise environments.
